materialChanges: Separated the unknown population mean, the true standard error sigma divided by square root n, its plug-in estimate s divided by square root n, and the square-root-of-two standard error for a difference between independent equal-precision means.

Rekeyed precision bands and repeat-study interpretations throughout the scenes, assessment, glossary, claims, and model chart so normal 68% and 95% coverage is centred on the population quantity rather than the realised first-sample mean.

Restated the central limit theorem with independence, common-population, and finite-variance conditions; separated exact mean and variance identities from asymptotic normal shape; and removed the size-30 guarantee and observed-maximum tail inference.

Relabelled the individual-value curve as a hypothetical normal comparison, preserved the actual cohort as right-skewed, added a self-contained empirical summary, and removed unsupported middle-two-thirds and middle-95% readings for that cohort.

Made unlabelled dispersion figures indeterminate until the authors identify the statistic and method, retaining square-root-n calculations only as conditional consequences rather than proof of identity.

Replaced the individual diagnostic-threshold comparison and unsupported change-detection sample sizes with population-level precision targets for one mean and for a difference between two independent means, including the limits of precision-only planning.

Defined standard deviation for any distribution, distinguished sample s from population sigma, added the worked-example self-explanation prompt, and synchronized assessment logic, claims, references, attribution, glossary, and accessible chart descriptions.

reviewDispositions.rationale: Scenes 020, 030, 040, 060, 070, and 080; item-one-se-band; the charts; claims; and glossary now centre a sampling distribution on the unknown population mean and use an estimated difference SE of square root of two times 2.324, or 3.29 mg/dL, when comparing two independent means of 60.

The learner-visible theorem now states independent same-population observations with finite mean and variance, gives exact expectation and variance identities, reserves asymptotic language for normal shape, and distinguishes sigma divided by square root n from the plug-in estimate using s.

The size-30 convention and the claim that the observed maximum licenses normality were removed. Scene 050 and the CLT assessment now use an explicit conditions-and-tail decision order and state that no universal finite-sample threshold follows from the theorem.

The individual-values chart is explicitly a hypothetical normal model rather than the cohort distribution. Scene 040 carries forward a text table of empirical cohort features, and practice and assessment no longer assign normal 68% or 95% coverage to the skewed cohort.

The reading rule, poster practice, assessment key, common errors, and discrimination rubric now say the statistic is indeterminate until labelled. Multiplication or division by square root n is used only to calculate conditional implications.

The NIDDK thresholds, health-sensitive claim, source record, and ecological comparison were removed. Scene 080 now states directly that a population mean cannot classify individuals and defers proportion estimation.

Scene 080 now plans to explicit estimated-SE targets: 81 observations for one mean at 2.00 mg/dL and 162 per year for an independent mean difference at 2.00 mg/dL. It states that detecting a 5 mg/dL change additionally requires alpha, power, sidedness, design, variance, dependence, and attrition assumptions.

The glossary now defines standard deviation for any distribution and distinguishes sample s, population sigma, and a sampling-distribution standard deviation. Scenes 010, 030, 040, and 080 consistently describe 18 mg/dL as an observed sample statistic and population estimate.

The worked example now ends with a self-explanation prompt asking why n counts independent people rather than rows or repeated measurements and how that decision determines whether the estimated SE is defensible.

Scene 040 now names the earlier centre-spread-shape lesson in prose and embeds a self-contained Markdown table with the cohort range, tail counts, largest bin count, and count inside the erroneous SE band.

This was a positive first-read note with no requested resolution. The concrete opener, ordinary-language motivation, diagnostic route, and scope boundary were retained while only the inaccurate population-range wording was narrowed to the observed cohort.

This was a positive alignment note with no requested resolution. The eight-scene sequence, objective set, faded practice, transfer task, and assessment mappings were preserved; corrections were integrated within that existing arc.

evidenceChecked: All eight scenes retain one level-one heading, logical Markdown source order, descriptive headings, and text-first prompts that do not depend on hover, drag, colour, sound, motion, position, or timing.

The two declarative local charts retain alt text and detailed long descriptions; their quantities and instructional comparison also appear in prose, and the skewed cohort evidence is available as a Markdown table.

Equations use dollar-delimited TeX, define their symbols and assumptions in adjacent prose, and are interpreted in words; no raw HTML, HTML entities, JavaScript, remote embeds, executable notebooks, or active media appear.

Every check and assessment has a non-timed text or numeric route, calculator use is allowed, answer logic and remediation remain available after an attempt, and no physical or personal-health-data task is required.
Every mapped material claim appears in a same-scene source note with complete source IDs; all claim and source references resolve after removal of the NIDDK claim and source.

All three retained sources are recorded as facts-only research with original expression, dated agent-access observations, source licences, rights bases, and rights evidence; the CC BY 4.0 contributor grant and agent disclosure remain in lesson.json and ATTRIBUTION.md.
thirdPartyAssets remains empty; both chart sources, cases, tables, prompts, calculations, alt text, and long descriptions are identified as original pack material.

The pack contains no identifiable patient or learner data, secrets, unsafe instructions, diagnostic recommendation, credential claim, or clinical decision rule; every clinical setting is explicitly fictional and educational.
limitations: No live screen-reader, keyboard, 200% zoom, reflow, reduced-motion, browser-render, print, or unavailable non-web export test was performed; the audit is source-level.

Per the operator's explicit restrictions, npm validation, strict source preflight, repository scripts, and site schemas were not run or read. JSON parsing and pack-local structural, identity, claim-note-source, reference-field, Markdown, and acceptable-response checks were performed instead.

The finalizer did not independently refetch source pages or terms. It checked the retained rights and access records, attribution, the academic review's source observations, and the absence of reused third-party expression or assets.
Equivalent non-dismissed GitHub COMMENTED transports are accepted from the operator-supplied record; this run did not query GitHub.

rationale: The standard-lesson input gate is satisfied by one academic and one learning-design advisory review of the exact original candidate across two distinct declared agent runs and providers. Both inputs requested changes; all ten change findings were incorporated and both positive notes were explicitly disposed without unnecessary rewriting. The final content now distinguishes population parameters, sample statistics, sampling distributions, and independent mean differences; bounds the central limit theorem; corrects the chart, assessment, clinical, and planning interpretations; and preserves the original instructional arc. Pack-local parsing and integrity checks passed, the accessibility-and-rights source audit is satisfied subject to its stated limitations, and no content blocker remains. The shared principal and provenance are disclosed and attested rather than treated as verified independence, and neither reviewer is represented as approving the final edit.
dissent: Both eligible advisory reviews returned request-changes against the original candidate; their concerns and resolutions remain visible in the indexed dispositions, and neither reviewer inspected or approved the final revision.
The learning-design reviewer declared principal-level conflict because github:VSBDev operates the founding-stage runs; only agent-run and declared-provider separation is represented.
No real learner testing or live assistive-technology testing was available.
conditions: The operator must commit this exact final lesson revision with both cited reviews present, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character commit SHA, and make no further teaching-content change.

Before merge, the operator must run the repository-required strict source preflight and validation and resolve any schema or deterministic-build defect without misrepresenting this adjudication; any teaching-content repair would require a newly authorized finalization path.
After the final commit is recorded, the maintainer may make only the permitted publication transition for lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim review-status fields.
